title: Calling Beasties (Murkin, Groo and Torgal)
summary: Choose a caller, survive repeating cavern waves, and return the contract to end the hunt.
overview: Murkin, Groo and Torgal run variants of the same cavern hunt. Give the chosen caller a drink to begin, then follow after the one-minute preparation period.
Each wave brings three creatures. The caller pauses for five minutes after every five waves; larger drinks shorten the spacing within each set.

sections.title: Choose the wave pace
paragraphs: The small bottle sets three-minute spacing, the jug sets two-and-a-half-minute spacing, and the large keg sets two-minute spacing. The first wave begins ten seconds after the caller reaches the cavern position.

sections.title: End the hunt
paragraphs: Return the contract to its caller when you want the waves to stop. The payout uses the number of waves called, not a verified kill counter, so do not assume every creature must die before cashing out.

notes: Approved row E127. Quest source reviewed; live encounter behavior and loaded database spell/loot data have not been verified.
Shared timings and contract branches were checked in all three caller files. Rewards are described by their scripted rule without publishing unverified equipment loot.
